remarks: Stunning colonial with beautiful architectural detalis located in sought after cul-de-sac. Home has been renovated throughout with all the luxury features for today's lifestyle. First floor includes Living Room, Dining Room, Gourmet Kitchen, Family Room plus home office. 6 spacious bedrooms, 5 full baths and 2 half baths. Plus a finished lower level with a fireplace and full bath. All this set on a pristine acre with a swimming pool!! A must see!!  Tenant is responsible for Credit Check, all utilities, 1st months rent plus 2 months security at time of signing. No smoking. Ask about pets.
